integrity: Analytical proof, standalone standard-library computational checker and recorded output provided. Finite checks do not establish infinite spectral assertions.
scientific_limitations: For fixed initial x in (-1,1] and a >= 1, with MA coefficient -1; not a uniform-in-initial-state estimate, and not a result for other innovation distributions. Older implicit spectral identities may overlap; independent historical priority remains unassessed.
title: A unique accelerated starting state for the conditioned uniform moving-average chain
